article_content: 'Tim Russert, a leading political journalist, died Friday at the age of 58, the network announced. He was renowned for hosting NBC\'s Meet the Press and served as a trusted voice in American politics.' 'Russert reportedly collapsed at work in Washington, D.C., and was taken to Sibley Memorial Hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Tom Brokaw shared the news on NBC shortly afterward.' 'He had recently returned from a family trip to Italy with his wife, Maureen Orth, and their son, Luke, celebrating Luke\'s graduation from Boston College. Brokaw said the news division would never be the same without Russert\'s strong voice.' 'Friends and colleagues praised Russert not only for his journalistic influence, but also for his warmth, his Catholic faith, and his unwavering love for the Buffalo Bills. James Carville recalled enjoying Washington Nationals games with him, expressing shock at his sudden death.' 'Born May 7, 1950, in Buffalo, New York, Russert was the son of Timothy John Russert Sr. (Big Russ) and Elizabeth Russert. Buffalo\'s mayor ordered flags lowered to half-staff in his honor. Russert graduated from Canisius High School, John Carroll University, and Cleveland-Marshall College of Law, later serving as press secretary for former New York Gov. Mario Cuomo and chief of staff to Sen. Daniel Patrick Moynihan.' 'Joining NBC in 1984, Russert quickly rose to prominence, eventually becoming senior vice president and Washington bureau chief. Among his notable achievements, he negotiated a historic Today show broadcast with Pope John Paul II in 1985 and won numerous awards, including an Emmy for his coverage of President Ronald Reagan\'s funeral.' 'His books Big Russ and Me (2004) and Wisdom of Our Fathers (2006) became best sellers, further endearing him to audiences who found his personal story inspiring. He often credited his upbringing and family for keeping him grounded, even as he interviewed powerful figures.' 'Under his leadership, Meet the Press became the most-watched Sunday political talk show in America, earning Russert accolades as one of the most important journalists in Washington. President George W. Bush called him tough and well-informed, praising his thorough interviews. TIME magazine named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world in 2008.' 'Brokaw noted that 2008 was a particularly meaningful year for Russert, who was deeply immersed in presidential campaign coverage. His dedication to politics, work ethic, and genuine enthusiasm left a lasting impact and secured his place as a respected journalist.'

Shi ne mashahurin mai gabatar da Meet the Press na NBC kuma amintaccen murya a siyasar Amurka.' 'An ce Russert ya fadi a wurin aikinsa a Washington, D.C., aka kai shi asibitin Sibley Memorial, inda aka tabbatar da rasuwarsa. Tom Brokaw ne ya bayyana labarin a NBC jim kadan bayan hakan.' 'Kwanan nan, Russert ya dawo daga wata tafiya tare da iyalinsa zuwa Italiya don bikin yaye dansa, Luke, daga Boston College. Brokaw ya bayyana cewa sashen labaran ba zai taba zama iri daya ba ba tare da karfin murya irin na Russert ba.' 'Abokai da abokan aiki sun yaba masa ba kawai don tasirinsa a fannin jarida ba, har ma da halayensa, addininsa na Katolika, da goyon bayan da yake bai wa kungiyar kwallon kafa ta Buffalo Bills. James Carville ya bayyana alhini kan rasuwarsa kwatsam.' 'An haifi Russert a ranar 7 ga Mayu, 1950, a Buffalo, New York; mahaifinsa Timothy John Russert Sr. (Big Russ) da mahaifiyarsa Elizabeth Russert. Magajin garin Buffalo ya umarta a sauke tutoci zuwa rabi don girmamawa. Russert ya kammala karatu daga Canisius High School, Jami\'ar John Carroll, da Cleveland-Marshall College of Law, kuma ya taba aiki a matsayin sakataren watsa labarai na tsohon gwamnan New York, Mario Cuomo, da kuma shugaban ma\'aikata ga Sanata Daniel Patrick Moynihan.' 'Ya fara aiki da NBC a shekarar 1984, inda ya zama shugaban sashen siyasa da kuma shugaban ofishin NBC a Washington. Daga cikin manyan nasarorinsa akwai tattaunawa da Pope John Paul II a wani shirin Today a 1985, da lambar yabo da dama, ciki har da Emmy don daukar nauyin jana\'izar Shugaba Ronald Reagan.' 'Littafansa Big Russ and Me (2004) da Wisdom of Our Fathers (2006) sun zama fitattun littattafai, inda mutane da dama suka jinjina wa labarinsa mai cike da karfin gwiwa. Ko da yake yana fuskantar shugabanni masu karfi a hira, koyaushe yana cewa iyalinsa su ne tushe a rayuwarsa.' 'A karkashinsa, Meet the Press ya zama shirin tattaunawa na siyasa mafi kallo a Amurka rannar Lahadi, lamarin da ya sa aka duba Russert a matsayin daya daga cikin manyan \'yan jarida a Washington. Shugaba George W. Bush ya kirashi jarumin dan jarida mai cikakken masaniya, inda yake yabawa tsayuwarsa tsayin daka. Mujallar TIME ma ta saka sunansa a jerin mutane 100 da suka fi tasiri a duniya a shekarar 2008.' 'Brokaw ya ce shekarar 2008 na da muhimmanci sosai a rayuwar Russert, wanda ya dukufa ga daukar labaran zaben shugaban kasa. Himma da kwazo da nishadantarwarsa sun bar gagarumar tasiri, inda suka tabbatar da matsayinsa a matsayin dan jarida mai kima.'

article_content: 'The funeral of property tycoon Scot Young took place at Kensal Green Cemetery in west London, six weeks after his fatal fall from his penthouse balcony.' 'Over 100 mourners attended, including his former fiancée, Noelle Reno, his daughters Scarlet (21) and Sasha (19), and model-turned-businesswoman Caprice.' 'Mr Young’s ex-wife, Michelle, did not attend the ceremony.' 'His coffin, adorned with white roses and floral tributes spelling Daddy, was taken to the chapel for a one-hour service, then brought to the grave for burial.' 'Scot Young was once said to be worth £2 billion but lost much of his fortune, leading to a notorious divorce battle with Michelle. He was imprisoned briefly for refusing to disclose financial details.' 'He struggled with personal issues, including reported substance use and bipolar disorder, and was found impaled on railings after his fall on December 8.' 'Those close to him expressed shock and grief, remembering him with heartfelt messages. Noelle Reno, who had split from him, described his loss as devastating.'

article_content: CNN -- The mosque located on Prospect Street is not only Cambridge, Massachusetts largest mosque but also the city’s only one. Around 1,000 people a week, including immigrants, students, families, and residents from surrounding neighborhoods, come to pray up to five times a day as required by Islam. Known as the Cambridge mosque, it is operated by the Islamic Society of Boston and lies a short distance from the Red Line, which serves many of Boston’s universities and colleges. 'The mosque is open to everyone,' says spokesperson Nicole Mossalam. 'We don’t have a core membership. It’s very fluid.' Law enforcement officials say the mosque has attracted known terrorists and accused extremists, such as the alleged Boston Marathon bombers, 'Lady al Qaeda,' and an American fugitive wanted for possible ties to ISIS’ social-media division—too many, they say, for authorities to ignore. Juliette Kayyem, CNN national security analyst and former Department of Homeland Security assistant secretary, states: 'At some point, we must recognize that multiple individuals who have taken up arms against Americans, either here in Boston or abroad with ISIS, are affiliated with the mosque. As a result, the mosque will face scrutiny to see if there are others there who might be planning ill will.' At least 10 suspected or convicted terrorists have prayed at the mosque, a figure confirmed by a federal law enforcement official, court documents, and the mosque. 'None of these individuals, if and when they prayed at the ISB mosque, showed any sign of criminal or violent behavior. The Islamic Society of Boston unequivocally condemns ISIS and is deeply angered by the harm it has done to innocent lives—American, Iraqi, Syrian, and more,' Mossalam said. She noted that, generally, these individuals had not participated in the mosque’s community or events. There is no evidence indicating that Cambridge mosque officials had knowledge of or involvement with the suspects, nor do they preach any form of radical Islam. Still, the list of controversial worshipers is striking for their apparent ties to ISIS, al Qaeda, and other extremist entities aiming at the United States. One of the most prominent attendees is Dr. Aafia Siddiqui, a Pakistani neuroscientist educated at MIT who is serving an 86-year sentence in federal prison. Nicknamed 'Lady al Qaeda,' she has become a propaganda symbol for Islamic Jihad. ISIS militants who beheaded American journalist James Foley mentioned a prisoner exchange involving 'sister Dr. Afia Sidiqqi (sic).' CNN interviewed her sister Fowzia Siddiqui in Pakistan, who insisted that extremists had misused Aafia’s name: 'We want no violence in Aafia’s name,' she said. In 2008, Siddiqui was arrested in Afghanistan with documents relating to bomb-making, specifically for chemical and biological weapons, intending a 'mass casualty attack' against targets like the Statue of Liberty and the Brooklyn Bridge. Her second husband is the nephew of Khalid Sheik Mohammed, the primary planner of 9/11. Siddiqui was not tried for terrorism but instead for grabbing a gun and firing at FBI agents during interrogation. Another suspect linked to the mosque is Ahmad Abousamra, allegedly involved in ISIS’ social-media propaganda. Raised near Boston, he speaks both English and Arabic fluently and graduated from the University of Massachusetts Boston with a computer science degree. He disappeared from the U.S. in 2006 after supposedly receiving terror training in Yemen and fighting U.S. forces in Iraq. His friend, Tarek Mehanna, also prayed at the mosque and is serving 17 years in federal prison for translating material for al Qaeda in Iraq, the forerunner to ISIS. 'All Muslims must pray five times a day, and the Cambridge mosque is open for worship to everyone; no IDs are checked; no one is turned away. If we ever saw any criminal or violent conduct, we would step in immediately and alert the authorities,' Mossalam said. Meanwhile, Tamerlan Tsarnaev, one of the Boston Marathon bombers, was reportedly expelled from the mosque, according to a member who spoke to CNN after the bombing. Tsarnaev had outbursts during prayers, condemning Muslims’ inclusion of American holidays. The mosque acknowledges that Tamerlan and his brother Dzhokar, as well as their friend Ibragim Todashev, attended. Todashev was supposedly involved with Tamerlan in a triple homicide in Waltham, Massachusetts, and was about to sign a confession when he allegedly grabbed a knife and charged an FBI agent, who shot him fatally. The FBI investigated the matter and deemed the shooting justified. In June, federal prosecutors charged another mosque attendee, taxi driver Khairullozhon Matanov, with obstruction of justice in relation to the suspected marathon bombers. He allegedly invited the Tsarnaev brothers to dinner the night of the bombing and later deleted files and photos from his computer when he learned authorities might question him. 'We keep seeing incident after incident of young men associated with the mosque who become radicalized,' said retired DHS official Kayyem. 'That merits scrutiny into what’s happening there and whether others might be plotting harm,' she added. The mosque was established in 1981. One of its founders, Abdulrahman Alamoudi, is serving a 23-year sentence after a 2004 guilty plea related to 'ties to nations and organizations that support terrorism.' The mosque’s spokesperson said he severed his engagement with their organization before charges were brought. The FBI labeled Alamoudi’s prosecution as a 'major terrorism case.' Mossalam underscores the Islamic Society of Boston’s longstanding commitment to fostering interfaith connections, community outreach, and collaboration with all levels of government.
translated_content: CNN -- Masallacin da ke Prospect Street ba kawai mafi girma bane a Cambridge, Massachusetts, amma kuma shine masallaci daya tilo a birnin. Kusan mutane 1,000 a kowane mako, ciki har da 'yan ci rani, dalibai, iyalai, da mazauna yankunan da ke kewaye, sukan zo su yi salla har sau biyar a rana kamar yadda addinin Musulunci ke bukata. Ana kiransa Masallacin Cambridge, kuma Kungiyar Musulmi ta Boston (Islamic Society of Boston) ke tafiyar da shi. Yana kusa da Red Line wacce ke kaiwa zuwa jami’o’i da kwalejoji da dama a Boston. 'Masallacin a bude yake ga kowa,' in ji mai magana da yawun masallacin, Nicole Mossalam. 'Babu wasu mambobi da muke cewa sune muhimmai. Kowa yana iya shigowa.' Jami’an tsaro sun ce masallacin ya jawo hankalin wadanda aka sani da zargi na ta’addanci da masu tsattsauran ra’ayi, irin su wadanda ake zargi da harin Boston Marathon, 'Lady al Qaeda,' da wani dan kasar Amurka da ake nema dangane da yiwuwar alaka da bangaren sada zumunta na ISIS—matsala ce da suke ganin ba za a iya yi watsi da ita ba. Juliette Kayyem, mai nazarin tsaron kasa a CNN kuma tsohuwar sakatariyar mataimakin Ma’aikatar Tsaron Cikin Gida, ta ce: 'A wani lokaci, dole ne mu fahimci gaskiya cewa mutane da dama da suka dauki makami kan Amurkawa, ko a nan Boston ko a wajen kasar tare da ISIS, suna da alaka da wannan masallaci. Saboda haka, dole ne a binciki masallacin don gano ko akwai wasu ma da za su iya shirya mummunar nufi.' A kalla mutane 10 da ake zargi ko hukunta su kan aiki na ta’addanci sun taba yin salla a masallacin, kuma wannan adadi an tabbatar da shi daga jami’in hukumar tsaro ta tarayya, takardun kotu, da kuma masallacin kansa. 'Babu daya daga cikin wadannan mutane da, idan sun ziyarci ISB, suka nuna wani irin halin laifi ko tashin hankali. Kungiyar Musulmi ta Boston tana sukar ISIS kwata-kwata kuma tana cikin fushi da barnar da suka yi wa rayukan dimbin mutane—Amurkawa, Iraqi, Siriya da sauran su,' in ji Mossalam. Ta ce, a mafi yawan lokaci, wadannan mutane ba sa shiga al’amuran al’ummar masallacin ko shirye-shiryensa. Babu wani shaidar da ke nuna cewa masu masallacin Cambridge sun san da ko kuma suka taimaka wa wadanda ake zargi, kuma ba sa koyar da kowacce irin koyarwar masu tsattsauran ra’ayi. Duk da haka, jerin sunayen masu ibada da ake ce-ce-ku-ce a kansu abin ban mamaki ne saboda irin ci gaba da suke da shi da ISIS, al Qaeda, da sauran kungiyoyin masu tsattsauran ra’ayi da ke shirin kai hare-hare ga Amurka. Daya daga cikin fitattun masu zuwa masallacin shine Dakta Aafia Siddiqui, wata likitar kwakwalwa 'yar asalin Pakistan da ta karanci ilimi a MIT. Yanzu haka tana daurin shekaru 86 a gidan yari na tarayya. An fi saninta da suna 'Lady al Qaeda,' kuma ta zama wata alama ga masu zazzafar ra'ayi na jihadi. Mayakan ISIS da suka yanka dan jaridar Amurka James Foley sun ambaci bukatar musayar fursunoni da 'yar'uwa Dr. Afia Sidiqqi (sic).' CNN ta tattauna da 'yar'uwarta Fowzia Siddiqui a Pakistan, wacce ta ce an zafafa sunan Aafia da sunan 'yan ta’adda: 'Ba ma son tashin hankali da sunan Aafia,' in ji ita. A shekara ta 2008, an kama Siddiqui a Afghanistan dauke da takardun da suka shafi yin bama-bamai, musamman na sinadarai da makamai masu guba, da nufin aiwatar da 'harin kashe mutane da yawa' a gurare irin su Statue of Liberty da Gadar Brooklyn. Mijin ta na biyu shi ne dan'uwan Khalid Sheik Mohammed, wanda ake ganin shi ne jagoran shirya harin 9/11. Ba a gurfanar da Siddiqui bisa laifin ta’addanci ba, amma saboda kwace bindiga da harbi kan jami’an FBI lokacin tambayoyi. Wani da ake zargi da alaka da masallacin shi ne Ahmad Abousamra, ana bincikarsa dangane da yada labaran ISIS. An haife shi a wajen Boston, yana iya Turanci da Larabci sosai, kuma ya kammala karatu a Jami’ar Massachusetts Boston da digiri a fannin kimiyyar kwamfuta. An ce ya bace daga Amurka a 2006 bayan samun horo a Yemen da yaki da sojojin Amurka a Iraki. Abokinsa, Tarek Mehanna, wanda kuma ya taba yin salla a masallacin, yana yanke hukuncin shekaru 17 a gidan yari na tarayya saboda fassara kayayyakin al Qaeda a Iraki, wanda ake gani a matsayin asalin ISIS. 'Dukkannin Musulmi suna da wajibi su yi salla sau biyar a rana, kuma masallacin Cambridge a bude yake ga kowa; ba mu duba katin shaida; ba mu korar kowa. Idan muka ga wani hali na laifi ko tashin hankali, za mu gaggauta dakatar da shi kuma mu sanar da hukuma,' in ji Mossalam. A gefe guda, ana cewa an koresu Tamerlan Tsarnaev daga masallacin, a cewar wani mamba da ya zanta da CNN bayan harin bom na Boston Marathon. Tsarnaev ya rika yin matsin lamba yayin salla, yana sukar yadda Musulmi ke amincewa da bukukuwan Amurka. Masallacin ya tabbatar cewa Tamerlan da dan’uwansa Dzhokar, da abokinsu Ibragim Todashev, sun halarci masallacin. Ana zargin Todashev da hannu tare da Tamerlan a kisan mutane uku a Waltham, Massachusetts, kuma da yake gab da sa hannu kan wata shaidar rubutu, sai ake zargin ya dauki wuka, ya kai wa dan FBI hari, wanda ya harbe shi har lahira. Hukumar FBI ta ce sakamakon bincikensu harbin da aka yi masa daidai ne. A watan Yuni, masu gabatar da kara na tarayya sun zargi wani mai zuwa masallacin mai suna Khairullozhon Matanov da hana shari’a dangane da wadanda ake zargi da harin bom na Boston Marathon. Wai shi ne ya gayyaci ‘yan’uwan Tsarnaev zuwa cin abinci a daren da aka kai harin, kuma daga bisani ya goge takardu da hotuna daga kwamfutarsa bayan da aka ce za a iya bincikar sa. 'Muna ganin lamari bayan lamari na matasa da suka je masallacin kuma suka rikide zuwa masu tsattsauran ra’ayi,' in ji tsohon jami’in DHS, Kayyem. 'Wannan yana buqatar bincike kan abin da ke faruwa a wurin, da kuma ko akwai wasu da ke shirin aikata wani abu mugun,' in ji ta. Masallacin an kafa shi a 1981. Daya daga cikin wadanda suka kafa shi, Abdulrahman Alamoudi, yana daurin shekaru 23 bayan amsa laifi a 2004 kan 'alaka da kasashe da kungiyoyin da ke da dangantaka da ta’addanci.' Mai magana da yawun masallacin ya ce Alamoudi ya daina hulda da masallacin kafin a gurfanar da shi. Hukumar FBI ta bayyana shari’ar Alamoudi a matsayin 'babban shari’ar ta’addanci.' Mossalam ta jaddada cewa Kungiyar Musulmi ta Boston na da tarihin 'ginin gadar fahimtar addinai daban-daban, sada zumunci da fahimta,' tare da aiki da 'masu ruwa da tsaki na gwamnati a duk matakai.'

article_content:
Paul Scholes, the former Manchester United midfielder, has questioned how Louis van Gaal will fit Wayne Rooney, Robin van Persie, and Radamel Falcao into a single formation. While Scholes views Falcao, who arrived on loan from Monaco, as a remarkable talent, he suggests only two of those forwards can start at once. Writing for The Independent, Scholes praised Falcao's movement and goal-scoring prowess during his time with Porto, Atletico Madrid, and Monaco. He acknowledged that Falcao's arrival creates healthy competition in the attack, but he doubts a trio of Rooney, Van Persie, and Falcao would work all at once.

Scholes also highlighted Manchester United's substantial summer outlay of around £150 million for Luke Shaw, Ander Herrera, Marcos Rojo, Angel di Maria, and Daley Blind. He credits executive vice-chairman Ed Woodward for assembling a squad that should push for a top-four finish, even if the Premier League title remains out of reach. Scholes was disappointed to see academy graduate Danny Welbeck move to Arsenal in a £16 million deal, although he believes Welbeck can still score 10 to 15 goals a season.

Sir Alex Ferguson, the retired Manchester United manager, expressed his astonishment at the scale of spending in the current transfer market, pointing out that modern fees keep escalating and there might be no end in sight.
translated_content:
Paul Scholes, tsohon dan wasan tsakiya na Manchester United, ya nuna shakku kan yadda Louis van Gaal zai hada Wayne Rooney, Robin van Persie, da Radamel Falcao a cikin wata guda. Ko da yake Scholes yana ganin Falcao, wanda ya zo a kan aro daga Monaco, a matsayin zakakurin ɗan wasa, yana ganin cewa biyu kawai daga cikinsu za su fara wasa a lokaci guda. A rubutunsa a jaridar The Independent, Scholes ya yabi motsin Falcao da hazakarsa wajen zura kwallaye yayin wasansa a Porto, Atletico Madrid, da Monaco. Ya jaddada cewa zuwan Falcao zai kara gasa a bangaren 'yan gaba, amma yana shakkun yiwuwar hada Rooney, Van Persie, da Falcao duka a lokaci guda.

Har ila yau, Scholes ya bayyana irin makudan kuɗaɗen da Manchester United ta kashe a lokacin bazara, kusan fam miliyan 150, don siyan Luke Shaw, Ander Herrera, Marcos Rojo, Angel di Maria, da Daley Blind. Yana godiya ga mataimakin shugaban gudanarwar kulob din, Ed Woodward, saboda tara ƙungiyar da zai iya neman wuri a cikin manyan kungiyoyi huɗu, ko da yake samun taken gasar Premier har yanzu ba abu ne mai sauƙi ba. Scholes bai ji daɗin ganin ɗan wasan da aka fara horas da shi a kulob, Danny Welbeck, ya koma Arsenal kan fam miliyan 16 ba, duk da haka yana ganin Welbeck zai iya ci wa Arsenal kwallaye 10 zuwa 15 a kaka.

Sir Alex Ferguson, tsohon manajan Manchester United da ya ajiye aikin horarwa, ya bayyana mamakinsa game da yawon kuɗaɗen da ake kashewa a kasuwar saye da sayar da 'yan wasa a yanzu, yana mai cewa farashin canja wurin na ƙaruwa ne akai-akai kuma watakila ba za a iya sanin ƙarshensa ba.

article_content: Iowa Governor Terry Branstad, 68, was taken by ambulance to a local hospital on Monday after suddenly becoming ill at a public gathering in Johnston. His office noted he had been combating a cold for several days, and paramedics said preliminary tests pointed to a seasonal ailment. During the ambulance ride, the governor was awake and coherently responding. Lt. Gov. Kim Reynolds later assured the public that he was recovering well and would remain in the hospital overnight for observation as a precaution. Branstad, freshly inaugurated for a record-breaking sixth term, has experienced past health problems, including a 2000 heart attack and a blocked artery. Before being taken away, event attendees saw him struggle with speaking and balance. He initially tried to continue but ultimately lay down to wait for help. Earlier in the day, Branstad mentioned he and Reynolds had both been battling a cold or flu for a while, yet they had tried to keep their official schedules intact. Over the weekend, Governor Branstad attended Congressman Steve King's Freedom Summit, where several Republican presidential hopefuls gathered. The governor encouraged them all to visit Iowa's 99 counties if they hoped to win support in the upcoming 2016 contest, emphasizing that frequent, direct engagement with voters is crucial for any campaign hoping to succeed in the state.
translated_content: Gwamnan Jihar Iowa Terry Branstad, mai shekaru 68, an dauke shi da motar asibiti zuwa asibiti a ranar Litinin bayan ramewa lafiyarsa cikin gaggawa a wani taron jama'a a Johnston. Ofishinsa ya bayyana cewa yana fama da mura har na wasu kwanaki, kuma likitoci sun ce gwaji na farko ya nuna cewa cuta ce ta yanayi. Yayin da ake tafiya da shi a cikin motar asibiti, gwamnan yana cikin hayyacinsa kuma yana mayar da amsa. Mataimakiyar Gwamna Kim Reynolds daga bisani ta tabbatar da cewa yana samun sauki sosai kuma zai kwana a asibiti domin a kula da shi. Branstad, wanda aka rantsar a karo na shida a baya-bayan nan, ya taba fuskantar matsalolin lafiya a baya, ciki har da bugun zuciya a shekarar 2000 da samun makuwar jini a wata hanya. Kafin a dauke shi, wasu da suka halarci taron sun ga yana kokawa da surutu da daidaituwar gangar jiki. Da farko ya nemi ci gaba da jawabinsa amma daga baya sai da ya kwanta har zuwa lokacin da aka dauke shi. A safiyar rana guda, Branstad ya bayyana cewa shi da Reynolds dukkansu suna fama da mura ko zazzaɓi tun kwanaki da suka gabata, duk da haka sun ci gaba da ayyukansu na hukuma. A karshen mako da ya gabata, Gwamna Branstad ya halarci Freedom Summit na wakilin majalisar tarayya Steve King, inda 'yan takarar shugaban kasa na Jam'iyyar Republican suka hadu. Gwamnan ya kuma karfafa musu gwiwa da su kai ziyara ga duk kananan hukumomi 99 na Iowa idan suna son samun goyon baya a zaben 2016 mai zuwa, yana jaddada cewa yin taruka da mutanen jihar akai-akai abu ne mai matukar muhimmanci.

article_content: Masculinity has gained fresh attention in popular media, often through comedic ads that taunt men with calls to (Man up). A prominent example is a Miller Lite commercial running during NFL games, where a man is scolded for not living up to certain masculine expectations for the second time in one day. In another ad from McDonald’s, a newlywed couple delays their honeymoon so the husband can savor a returning menu item, the McRib. The frustrated bride reacts by comparing him to a teenager, saying she regrets marrying someone seemingly stuck in adolescence. Hit television shows this season echo the theme of questioning modern manhood. According to the Wall Street Journal, six fresh series zero in on men’s shifting roles, including aptly named titles like (Last Man Standing), (How To Be A Gentleman), and (Man Up!). These comedies often depict men as immature or irresponsible, hinting at doubt surrounding today’s definition of masculinity. Shifts in social dynamics, the workforce, and women’s rising achievements have increased the ambiguity of men’s roles, resulting in entertaining storylines but strained family relationships. Although men generally lead in major professions such as science, business, and politics, signs of change are everywhere. For instance, the number of female Fortune 500 CEOs has reached a record high, and now, in the United States, more women than men receive both bachelor’s degrees and higher-level educational qualifications. These trends add to the discussion about men struggling in areas of work, marriage, and spirituality, a topic I explored earlier on CNN. Responses from readers, especially women, revealed that the situation might be more dire than anticipated. Some reported lowering their expectations when looking for a partner, feeling that men hold them back or weigh them down. One woman lamented that if 60 is the new 40, then 25 seems to be the new 13 for many men. While certain feminist groups aim to minimize men’s societal importance, the majority of women want competent male partners who are their equals. Families benefit when both men and women are strong, but many modern men seem uncertain about their purpose, even as they enjoy unprecedented freedom to choose their paths. Only a century ago, men had little choice but to grow up fast to survive. Today, countless options and heightened confusion can paralyze some men, leading to questionable responses. Consider the Occupy Wall Street protests, where slogans and demands reflect less emphasis on personal responsibility and more on handouts like free college or mandated income support. Traditionally, men solved their livelihood challenges personally, using their skills and diligence. Now, government welfare can take over for those who prefer it, creating a struggle between autonomy and dependency. This raises the pivotal question: what does it mean to be a man in these times? Boys learn to become men through role models—a concept known as mimesis. Parents, coaches, teachers, and fictional heroes can all shape a boy’s notion of manhood. My single mother ensured my brother and I encountered strong male figures: priests, instructors, and coaches who guided us. I personally admired figures like Gary Cooper in (High Noon), who embodied moral fortitude and compassion, as well as historical and religious icons such as Lou Gehrig, Abraham Lincoln, King David, Esther, Mother Courage, and Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. Today, recognizable heroes with clear values are less abundant, and when asked about role models, many boys draw a blank. We need to illustrate what virtues deserve admiration. As author Tom Wolfe suggested, our era demands a collective relearning, particularly for guiding young males toward responsible adulthood. A proverb reminds us that a child properly guided will not stray when older. William J. Bennett asserts these issues are urgent for our society’s future.
translated_content: Maza sun sāke saurare sosai a kafofin watsa labarai na zamani, galibi ta hanyar tallace-tallacen ban dariya da ke tsokanar maza da kiran su su (tashi tsaye kamar namiji). Mafi fitacciyar misali shi ne tallan Miller Lite da ake nunawa yayin wasannin NFL, inda wani mutum ake zarginsa da gazawa wajen cika abubuwan da ake tsammani daga namiji karo na biyu a rana guda. A wani tallan McDonald’s kuma, wani ma’aurata da suka auri juna kwanan nan sun dage balaguron watan maduwa domin mijin ya sami damar dandana sabuwar sanarwar kayan abinci da aka dawo da shi wato McRib. Amaryar da ke cike da takaici ta kwatanta shi da matashin da ba a gama girma ba, tana mai cewa ta yi nadamar auren wanda ke tafiya da hankalin wani matashi. Wasu shirye-shiryen talabijin masu tashe a wannan lokaci sun jaddada tambayoyin da ake yi kan hanyar zamanin namiji a yau. A cewar jaridar Wall Street Journal, akwai shirye-shiryen guda shida da ke mayar da hankali kan yadda rawar maza ke sauyawa, ciki har da sunaye irin su (Last Man Standing), (How To Be A Gentleman), da (Man Up!). A waɗannan shirye-shiryen, kawai ana nuna maza a matsayin marasa tsari ko sakaci, abin da ke nuna shakku game da ma’anar namiji a zamanin nan. Canje-canje a dangantakar al’umma, fannin aiki, da ci gaban da mata ke samu suna ƙara rikitar da matsayin maza, wanda ke haifar da labaran ban dariya amma kuma yana zamowa matsala ga dangin iyali. Ko da yake maza har yanzu suna jagoranci a fannoni kamar kimiyya, kasuwanci, da siyasa, alamun canji suna nan ko’ina. Alal misali, yawon mata da ke rike mukamin Babban Darakta a manyan kamfanoni (Fortune 500) ya kai matakin da ba a taba gani ba, sannan yanzu a Amurka, mata suna samun digirorin bachelor da sauran takardun karatu na gaba da shi fiye da maza. Wadannan ci gaban na ƙara fito da batun yadda maza ke fuskantar ƙalubale a fannoni na aiki, aure, da ruhaniya, wanda na tattauna a baya a CNN. Amsoshin da na samu daga masu karatu, musamman mata, sun bayyana cewa yanayin na iya zama mafi muni fiye da yadda aka zata. Wasu sun ce suna rage burinsu wajen neman abokin rayuwa, suna ganin cewa maza suna ja da baya ko nauyi a gare su. Wata mace ma ta koka da cewa idan 60 shi ne sabuwar 40, to a wurin wasu maza 25 kamar sabon 13 ne. Duk da yake wasu kungiyoyin masu fafutukar kare hakkin mata suna kokarin rage muhimmancin maza a cikin al’umma, yawancin mata suna bukatar abokan zama maza masu kwarewa da daidaiton da su. Iyali na ci gaba idan maza da mata duk karfi ne a tare da su, amma da yawa daga cikin mazan zamani suna shiga shakku game da manufarsu, ko da yake suna da ’yanci fiye da kowane zamani don zabar hanyar rayuwarsu. Kusan karni daya da ya gabata, maza ba su da wani zabi face girma da wuri don su tsira. A yanzu, yawancin zaɓuka da ruɗani sun kai ga wasu maza tur da baya, suna haifar da martani masu tantama. Ka kalli zanga-zangar Occupy Wall Street, inda taken da buƙatu ke nuna ƙarancin mayar da hankali kan alhakin kai da ƙarin roƙon tallafi kamar karatun jami’a kyauta ko wajibcin albashi. A al’ada, maza sukan magance matsalolin rayuwarsu da kansu, suna amfani da basira da ƙwazon su. Yanzu, tallafin gwamnati na iya maye gurbinsu ga waɗanda suka fi so, abin da ke haddasa rikici tsakanin ’yancin kai da dogaro da wasu. Wannan yana haifar da wata babbar tambaya: mene ne ma’anar zama namiji a wannan lokaci? Samari suna koyon zama maza ta wurin koyi da wasunsu – abin da ake kira mimesis. Iyayen su, masu horo, malamai, da jarumai na almara za su iya tsara yadda yaro yake fahimtar namiji. Mahaifiyata daya tilo ta tabbatar da cewa ni da ɗan’uwana mun sadu da mazaje masu karfi: firistoci, malamai, da masu horo da suka jagorance mu. Ni kaɗai na ji daɗin lura da jaruman irin su Gary Cooper a (High Noon), wanda ke wakiltar tsayuwar daka ta ɗabi’u da tausayi, haka kuma da fitattun mutane a tarihin addini kamar su Lou Gehrig, Abraham Lincoln, Sarki Dauda, Esther, Mother Courage, da Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. A yau, jaruman da ake iya gani da kuma manufofi a bayyane ba su da yawa, kuma idan aka tambayi yara wanene ginshikin koyi ga su, da yawa basa da amsa. Dole ne mu nuna waɗanne halaye suka cancanci girmamawa. Kamar yadda marubuci Tom Wolfe ya nuna, wannan zamani yana bukatar sake koyon darussa tare, musamman wajen shiryar da samari ga girma mai alhaki. Wani karin magana yana cewa idan an tarbiyyantar da yara da kyau, to ba za su bata ba a lokacin manyantaka. William J. Bennett yana cewa waɗannan matsalolin suna da mahimmanci ga makomar al’umma.
